item.ptxt: When using SST (TaSCAN) with the ignition switch OFF, repeatedly turn any door courtesy light switch ON/OFF (at intervals of 1.5 seconds or less) until communication between SST (TaSCAN) and the vehicle starts.

step3.ptxt: With the ignition switch OFF, connect SST (TaSCAN) to DLC3.
Following the SST (TaSCAN) screen display, display the [Diagnosis] → [Body] → [Certification] → [DTC] screen and check the DTCs.

atten4.ptxt: DTCs are output even with the ignition switch OFF.

step3.ptxt: With the ignition switch OFF, connect SST (TaSCAN) to DLC3.
Following the SST (TaSCAN) screen display, display the [Diagnosis] → [Body] → [Main Body] → [DTC] screen and check the DTCs.

atten4.ptxt: DTCs are output even with the ignition switch OFF.

step3.ptxt: With the ignition switch OFF, connect SST (TaSCAN) to DLC3.
Following the SST (TaSCAN) screen display, display the [Diagnosis] → [Body] → [Certification] → [DTC] screen and clear the DTCs.

item.ptxt: If they cannot be cleared, start again from the ignition switch OFF condition.
Do not clear DTCs using SST (TaSCAN) until the cause has been identified.
